title: containers: don't panic on ancestor filters with a tag

#### What this PR does / why we need it:

Fix the panic in buildah containers --filter ancestor= when a listed container's image name has no `:`

#### How to verify it

`go test -tags "exclude_graphdriver_btrfs containers_image_openpgp" ./cmd/buildah/ -run 'TestMatchesReferenceNameWithoutTag'  -v`

#### Which issue(s) this PR fixes:

Fixes #7201
